main_text.p: gnas iudicasse: easq; ( ut bo- nus auctor scribit Diony- sius) ferè ad seruos, infimám que plebem relegasse. Quod eodē modo de Medicina factum constat: quippe quum aut seruis ea disciplina insti- tutis, aut hominibus è Græ- cia adductis, eam ad rem ute rentur: nimirū qui ea tracta- rent & agerent, à quibus his etiam temporibus non mo- dò qui nobili sunt genere, ue rùm etiā qui paulo illustrio- re ingenio prædití[?] sunt, ab- horrent.. Iam verò popu- lum R.o. iis in artibus, quarū studia digna esse statuit in quibus elaboraret, ceteris om-

page.notes: The running head and page number are read from a small scan; the page number is doubtful. The word "prædití" is doubtful. A small dot stands in the right margin beside "ue" in the line "dò qui nobili sunt genere, ue"; it is not a note. The paragraph continues from the previous page and runs on to the next. Long s has been normalised to s, and i/j, u/v follow the spelling rules.
